svg.title: Buff Your Money stack
svg.desc: Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, TanStack Query. Backend: Next.js server, MCP server, pg-boss queue. Data: PostgreSQL 16, Drizzle ORM, decimal.js. AI: None inside the app, MCP for the user's agent. Ops: Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI, Vitest, Playwright
svg.text: Versions as pinned in the project.
